<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<style>
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 30px;
    background: #050806;
    font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', Menlo, monospace;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
  }
  .window {
    background: #0a0f0c;
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 0 1px rgba(80,255,150,0.08);
    max-width: 1180px;
    width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid #142018;
  }
  .titlebar {
    background: #0d1310;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #142018;
  }
  .dot { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; }
  .red { background: #ff5f56; }
  .yellow { background: #ffbd2e; }
  .green { background: #27c93f; }
  .content {
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    padding: 36px 40px;
    gap: 40px;
  }
  .portrait-wrap {
    flex: 0 0 320px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    justify-content: center;
    padding-top: 8px;
  }
  .portrait-wrap img {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 320px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    display: block;
  }
  .info {
    flex: 1;
    padding-top: 4px;
  }
  .name {
    color: #4dffb0;
    font-size: 28px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
  }
  .name .sub {
    color: #6fffb0;
    font-weight: 400;
    font-size: 20px;
  }
  .rule {
    height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #2fdc8a, transparent);
    margin: 14px 0 22px 0;
  }
  ul.skills {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
  }
  ul.skills li {
    color: #dfe8e2;
    font-size: 15.5px;
    line-height: 1.9;
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }
  ul.skills li .icon {
    flex: 0 0 22px;
  }
  .hl-cyan { color: #4fd8ff; font-weight: 600; }
  .hl-yellow { color: #ffd84f; font-weight: 600; }
  .hl-green { color: #6fffb0; font-weight: 600; }
  .hl-pink { color: #ff8fd8; font-weight: 600; }
  .prompt {
    margin-top: 26px;
    padding-top: 16px;
    border-top: 1px solid #142018;
    color: #4dffb0;
    font-size: 15px;
  }
  .prompt .cursor {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 9px;
    height: 16px;
    background: #4dffb0;
    margin-left: 6px;
    vertical-align: middle;
    animation: blink 1s step-start infinite;
  }
  @keyframes blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } }
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="window">
    <div class="titlebar">
      <div class="dot red"></div>
      <div class="dot yellow"></div>
      <div class="dot green"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="content">
      <div class="portrait-wrap">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Kashif Agha" />
      </div>
      <div class="info">
        <div class="name">KASHIF AGHA <span class="sub">(Kay)</span></div>
        <div class="rule"></div>
        <ul class="skills">
          <li><span class="icon">💻</span><span>Senior <span class="hl-cyan">Full-Stack .NET Developer</span> with <span class="hl-yellow">25+ Years</span> of Industry Experience</span></li>
          <li><span class="icon">🧩</span><span>Deep expertise in <span class="hl-cyan">C#</span>, <span class="hl-cyan">ASP.NET Core</span>, <span class="hl-cyan">SQL Server</span> &amp; enterprise application architecture</span></li>
          <li><span class="icon">☁️</span><span>Extensive <span class="hl-green">Azure</span> experience — Functions, DevOps Pipelines, Blob Storage, Key Vault &amp; ARM Templates</span></li>
          <li><span class="icon">⚛️</span><span>Modern frontend with <span class="hl-cyan">React</span> &amp; <span class="hl-cyan">TypeScript</span>, building responsive full-stack apps</span></li>
          <li><span class="icon">🧱</span><span>Building <span class="hl-yellow">Microservices</span> with <span class="hl-yellow">Kafka</span>, <span class="hl-yellow">PostgreSQL</span> &amp; Docker — incl. self-directed project <span class="hl-pink">CornerCart</span></span></li>
          <li><span class="icon">🔐</span><span>API Gateway design with <span class="hl-cyan">YARP</span> &amp; secure auth via <span class="hl-cyan">JWT</span></span></li>
          <li><span class="icon">🏥</span><span>Healthcare integrations using <span class="hl-green">HL7 / FHIR</span> (PrescribeIT, MedSync, PharmaNet)</span></li>
          <li><span class="icon">🔁</span><span>CI/CD with <span class="hl-cyan">Azure DevOps</span>, self-hosted agents &amp; infrastructure-as-code</span></li>
          <li><span class="icon">🤖</span><span>Exploring <span class="hl-pink">AI Agents</span> &amp; the <span class="hl-pink">Claude API</span> for automated code review and dev tooling</span></li>
          <li><span class="icon">🎓</span><span>Pursuing <span class="hl-yellow">AZ-305</span> certification alignment through structured self-directed learning</span></li>
          <li><span class="icon">💡</span><span>Passionate about <span class="hl-green">Software Architecture</span>, Clean Code &amp; mentoring through continuous learning</span></li>
        </ul>
        <div class="prompt">kay@fullstack:~$ <span class="cursor"></span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>
